bias.zh: 反弹 · 重新跌破 5 日和 10 日均线

read.en: Corning fell 4.5% on Nov 13 to $114.08, trading $110.56–119.17 on light volume (0.62x the 20-day average). It is below the rising 5-day ($116.4), the 10-day ($116.0), 30-day ($131.8), 100-day ($154.1) and rising 200-day ($156.6). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($102.70), and RSI is 40.2.
read.zh: 康宁 11月13日下跌 4.5%，收于 $114.08，盘中区间 $110.56–119.17，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.62 倍）。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$116.4）以及 10 日（$116.0）、30 日（$131.8）、100 日（$154.1）和上行的 200 日均线（$156.6）下方。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$102.70），RSI 为 40.2。

read.en: The close lost the 10-day and the $116.5–116.9 support, now resistance, and settled just under the $114.2–115.6 band. Resistance is $116–116.9 (10 and 5-day, Nov 11 low), then $119.2–120.9 (Nov 12–13 highs) and $123.2–123.9. Support is $110.1–112.7 (Nov 10, 12 and 13 lows), then $106.1 (Nov 6 close) and $102.7 (SAR). A close above $116.9 would target $119–121; below $110.1, $106.
